Create the missing `frontend/public` directory (if it does not exist) and add the 5 user-uploaded PNG files into it using these exact canonical filenames so the app’s existing asset resolution (`ASSET_PATHS` / fallback chains) can load them:
- `frontend/public/bg.png`
- `frontend/public/vinyl.png`
- `frontend/public/bodyhdd.png`
- `frontend/public/disk.png`
- `frontend/public/arm.png`

Ensure the three selected HDDHub `` elements render the newly added canonical public assets (no code changes outside these selected elements). The selected elements are: - Element 1 XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]/img[1]` - Element 2 XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/img[1]` - Element 3 XPath: `/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/img[1]` These correspond to the HDD hub’s body, disk, and arm image layers, which must load `bodyhdd.png`, `disk.png`, and `arm.png` from the public root via the existing fallback chains.
